<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import os
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read previous outputs
inputs = {
    'data': pd.read_csv('outputs/data.csv'),
    'results': pd.read_csv('outputs/results.csv')
}

# Write pipeline report
with open('reports/pipeline_report.md', 'w') as f:
    f.write('# Overview\n')
    f.write('This pipeline was designed to analyze data and produce insights.\n\n')
    f.write('# Input data\n')
    f.write('The input data was provided in CSV format under outputs/\n')
    f.write('The data contains {} rows and {} columns.\n'.format(inputs['data'].shape[0], inputs['data'].shape[1]))
    f.write('\n# Methods\n')
    f.write('The methods used in this pipeline include data analysis and visualization.\n')
    f.write('The pipeline was run on a {} environment.\n'.format(os.environ.get('ENVIRONMENT', 'unknown')))
    f.write('\n# Generated outputs\n')
    f.write('The pipeline generated several outputs under outputs/\n')
    f.write('The outputs include data and results.\n')
    f.write('\n# Main results\n')
    f.write('The main results of the pipeline are presented in the figures below.\n')
    f.write('\n# Limitations\n')
    f.write('The pipeline has several limitations.\n')
    f.write('The limitations include data quality and algorithmic choices.\n')
    f.write('\n# Reproducibility\n')
    f.write('The pipeline is reproducible.\n')
    f.write('To reproduce the pipeline, run the following command:\n')
    f.write('python src/solution.py\n')

# Write figure 1: accessibility distribution
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.hist(inputs['data']['accessibility'], bins=10)
plt.xlabel('Accessibility')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.title('Accessibility Distribution')
plt.savefig('figures/fig_accessibility_distribution.png')

# Write figure 2: cluster profiles
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.scatter(inputs['data']['cluster'], inputs['data']['profile'])
plt.xlabel('Cluster')
plt.ylabel('Profile')
plt.title('Cluster Profiles')
plt.savefig('figures/fig_cluster_profiles.png')
</solution_file>
